roadmapPhases.name: Phase 0: Harden what exists
roadmapPhases.goal: Make today's read and create broker, the Workbench explorer and the governance screens trustworthy before anything is built on them. This phase closes the 33 audit findings still open after batches 1 and 2 (#304, #306), plus the residual problems those batches reported. It also covers KMS, credential hygiene, MFA step-up, in-product onboarding, the Workbench write-back audit gap, catalogue address bugs and the sapsf.* hosts. It extracts the pipeline with no behaviour change and checks the permutation simulator into the repo. Batches 1 and 2 already fixed A00-A13, A20-A28, A31-A37, A39-A41, A48, A49, A53-A55 and A64-A68 (see git log c31a385c and 33d0ef86). Estimate: 5 to 6 weeks for 3 to 4 engineers.

roadmapPhases.name: Phase 1: Any SAP OData API, contract-first, with a Tenant Twin
roadmapPhases.goal:
Remove the blockers that zero out the most valid scenarios at the lowest cost:
- origin CUSTOMER_CUSTOM and PARTNER, about 330k scenarios (66.5%);
- the 0%-full ceiling on OData reads.

This phase lands the in-flight custom-service-path work first. It then compiles real contracts from $metadata, makes the read surface usable by real programs (filter, key, select, paging, field scope), and stands up the Tenant Twin, so a developer can call any API, including a Z* one, before Basis opens anything. Estimate: 8 to 10 weeks. The cell upgrades below are intentions to be confirmed by the P0.15 simulator.

roadmapPhases.name: Phase 2: Postman before code, full OData writes, every language
Phase 3: Govern every connected program as code
roadmapPhases.goal:
Answer the user's request that 'the external program connected is also being controlled and governed'. Each program declares itself in a manifest, gets checked before commit and in CI, is promoted through evidence-based gates, is held to policies and budgets, can be stopped in one click, and is watched by monitors and an upgrade radar.

This phase also lets SAP call external programs through governed outbound routes. It lifts the lifecycle stages that cap 'full' coverage today: CI_PRECOMMIT_GOVERNANCE (0) and DEPLOY/UPGRADE/MONITOR (1). Estimate: 10 to 12 weeks.
